Virgo — 4th (Ultimate) Technique, gained at level 16.

The Six Realms of Samsara — the soul sent to one of the six worlds while the body remains on the field.

The target must attempt a Will save.

Success It is stunned 1.

Failure Its soul is cast into one of the six realms for 1 minute: it is stunned for the duration, its body standing empty.

Critical Failure As failure but for 10 minutes, and on its return it is enfeebled 2 and stupefied 2 for an hour. No one comes back from the six worlds unchanged.

Heightening (+2 levels) At 20th level, you may target two creatures.

On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
